subject: RE: Encord/ Hydro-Québec
text:
Interne

Hi Alex,

Thank you for getting back to us. We have shown the meeting video to some researchers, and they are quite interested in testing out the tool as well. Some are a little skeptical about if it could handle large size cloud points data and detailed 360 images. I guess we would know better when we have a trial version and test Encore out fully.

As I have mentioned in the meeting, since we are a semi-public company owned partially by the Quebec government, the purchase process can take a long time to finalize. I would strongly suggest that we start the paperwork such as let the lawyers go through the service agreement and have an idea about the licensing to discuss more in depth with our manager.

Sincerely,
